Yeah I think we have a very decent fixture list this year. If we get 11 and then 13 points I will be delighted to be honest, and then if we went on to win the next 8? That'd be just outstanding. You're looking at around 50 points at the half way mark of the season with that kind of form. That's probably not going to happen, but somewhere in the 40's and we're definitely in with a shout.

Yeah the CL group games look to be falling in some awkward places, but I'm confident with a bigger/higher quality squad that we can manage them well - once we qualify that is!

I think the squad as a whole looked a bit stuttery because we weren't playing games as often as we were used to. And for a team learning a new system with a new manager and with some new players I think we could have benefited from those extra games. I think LVG will be more confident with a larger list of games. He struggled with experimenting last year. We had that MK Dons game where he just woefully underestimated the lower league's level, and that meant none of the youngsters could get a decent amount of games.

Also, without the group games some of our squad players struggled for game time, so we were stuck in a very slow methodic work through of players/systems where training (and fitness) were the only things he had to go by when selecting his squad every week. We would have seen a much quicker adaptation to his methods last year with the extra games, even if it was only 5-10 extra ones.

Those opening games against Spurs and Liverpool are so important. We need to take 6 points from those games to show intent to win the league, not just finish top 4.

It could be a tight finish too. Pretty much all of our last games are against teams you would expect to be fighting to stay out of the relegation zone so they won't be pushed over for easy points.
